Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be pleased to i. Direct the respondents to take immediate steps to pass the Supplementary Award in LAC 11/13 and Awards in LAC 1/15 and LAC 19/15 following Act 30 of 2013 and pay the amount with interest.
ii.Direct the respondents to immediately pay 80% of the compensation with due interest from the date of taking possession in LAC 1/15 and LAC 19/15.

sentences.text: This Court notices that in spite of passing a detailed order as above, respondents 3, 4 and 7 have not produced the details as directed.
3. The matter will stand posted on 19.05.2025.
The documents directed to be produced in paragraph 8 of the order dated 26.03.2025 are to be placed on record by the next posting date.
If respondents 3, 4 and 7 are not able to produce the details, as directed, the said respondents to be personally present before this Court 19.05.2025.

Sd/-
